ewar_vintage.note: data/ewar_v3.json is FanGraphs' published WAR from the frozen vintage plus the site's named departures; it moves only when it is rebuilt by hand.

components.why_it_stops: eWAR starts in 2000, the first season of the frozen FanGraphs WAR copy it is built on; that copy is never refetched, so an earlier season would need a new copy or another frame.

groups.text: 2000-2001: FanGraphs' batting, baserunning from wSB steals only, fielding, the positional, league and replacement terms and pitching.
groups.short: 2000-2001: baserunning is steals only (FanGraphs published no UBR or double-play runs for these seasons); no catcher framing (FanGraphs' WAR carries it from 2008).

groups.text: 2002-2007: FanGraphs' batting, baserunning (wSB steals, UBR and wGDP double plays), fielding, the positional, league and replacement terms and pitching.
groups.short: 2002-2007: no catcher framing (FanGraphs' WAR carries it from 2008).

groups.text: 2008-2015: FanGraphs' batting, baserunning (wSB steals, UBR and wGDP double plays), fielding and catcher framing, the positional, league and replacement terms and pitching.
2016-2025: FanGraphs' batting, baserunning (wSB steals and FanGraphs' other baserunning runs), fielding and catcher framing, the positional, league and replacement terms and pitching.

2026: FanGraphs' batting, baserunning (wSB steals and FanGraphs' other baserunning runs), fielding and catcher framing, the positional, league and replacement terms and pitching, plus eABS (ABS challenges).

field_notes.g: games PLAYED: the MAX of the hitting and pitching feed G, never their sum, because a two-way player's hitting games and pitching games are the same games. The eWAR BOARD's own `g` is the pitching feed's G alone, so a hitter reads blank there and a real number here. Two different questions, pinned apart by test_mlbstats_windows.
field_notes.war_bat: the batting side at full precision. The board prints it rounded to a tenth; a window sums these and rounds once.

note: One row per player-season, positional by `fields`. A window is the fold of these rows: counts add, the two eWAR sides sum UNROUNDED and round once. The board's Current view is this file folded at the live season, from the same read, in the same process. A season named in `groups_without_a_feed` carries its eWAR and no denominator for that side, so a window over it is short of one season's PA or IP and says so.
